name: the chain record is never asked
why: The feature itself: without the /ws/js branch every chain climbs area-rels as before. The text is the same, so only the request counts see it.

name: the walk ignores a loaded chain record
why: _mbPopAreaChain() must end the walk with the record's areas; without it the record is fetched and then never shown, and the chain stays incomplete.

name: an answer for another area is accepted
why: The endpoint is undocumented: an answer that is not this area must fall back to the climb.

name: a failed record does not switch /ws/js off
why: Without _mbPopChainOff the climb asks /ws/js again at every level it reaches: three failures for one line.

name: the area itself is kept in its own line
why: A containment that lists the area would name it twice (Long Branch, Long Branch, …).

name: the line's areas are not seeded
why: Each area of a record's line gets its tail in memory, so New Jersey's own chain needs no request.
